protocol.title: On-chip Integration of Droplet Microfluidics and Nanostructure-Initiator Mass Spectrometry for Enzyme Screening
protocol.platform: uNIMS (digital droplet microfluidics + NIMS array, EWOD-actuated)

protocol.objective: Integrate droplet microfluidics with nanostructure-initiator mass spectrometry (NIMS) into a unified uNIMS platform for time-resolved, label-free enzyme kinetics screening at picoliter-to-nanoliter scale, demonstrated on a glycoside hydrolase enzyme (CelE-CBM3a) at two pH conditions

device.name: uNIMS chip
layers: Glass substrate with 128 chrome electrodes (5 cm L x 500 um W x 375 um H) -- bottom electrode layer (layer iii)
SU-8-5 dielectric, 5 um thick -- spin-coated on electrode layer
PDMS fluidics channel layer, 500 um W x 225 um H -- channel for droplet transport
NIMS array chip (5 x 5 cm silicon wafer, 640 patterned NIMS pads) -- layer iv
PDMS mounting layer for interfacing fluidics to microfluidics -- layer ii
3D-printed PLA/PETG chassis (Ultimaker 2, 215 C extrusion) -- layers i and v

assembly.seal_type: Reversible PDMS compression seal between DMF chip and NIMS array
assembly.seal_purpose: Allows NIMS array removal and placement into mass spectrometer after experiment
assembly.pogo_pins: Bottom layer contains pogo pins in PCB for integration with Dropbot DMF control hardware
assembly.peek_tubing_gasket: Upper PDMS gasket sits between 3D-printed chassis and DMF chip for PEEK tubing interfacing

dmf_chip.electrode_dimensions: 5 cm L x 500 um W x 375 um H
functions: 31 digital arrayers for droplet actuation over NIMS pads

nims_array.etching_process: ICP-RIE (inductively coupled plasma reactive ion etching)
nims_array.pdms_development_solvent: Toluene, 10 s; rinse IPA and H2O
nims_array.nanostructure_description: Silicon nanostructures generated by DRIE; initiator-coated for laser desorption/ionisation

carrier_oil.name: Novec HFE-7500
carrier_oil.surface_treatment: 100 uL Picoglide (Dolomite Microfluidics, UK) pumped through channel for 30 min

enzyme.name: CelE-CBM3a (CelE)
enzyme.activity: Deconstructs plant hemicellulose (cleaves beta-1,4 glycosidic bonds in cellulose)
enzyme.supplier_reference: Deng et al., ACS Chem. Biol. 2014

validation_standard.name: Dextromethorphan (DXM)
validation_standard.purpose: Rudimentary testing of microfluidic functions and NIMS array evaluation; matrix-free ionisation confirmed

maldi_matrix.name: Universal MALDI matrix
maldi_matrix.application: Coated onto NIMS array after removal from uNIMS system prior to MS imaging

reaction_preparation.format: Off-chip premix in 0.5 mL eppendorf tube
reaction_preparation.composition: 4 uL buffer + 1 uL G4 substrate-probe + 1 uL CelE-CBM3a (240 ug/mL)
reaction_preparation.loading_method: 5 uL plug drawn into syringe tubing and injected onto uNIMS
reaction_preparation.droplet_generation: T-junction pressure-driven flow; aqueous plug broken into ~150 nL droplets by immiscible HFE-7500 oil
reaction_preparation.droplet_synchronisation: Matches droplet formation with electrode actuation for uniform spacing

quantification.rationale: Internal normalisation eliminates sensitivity to droplet volume variation; less sensitive to concentration measurement errors than direct quantification
quantification.analysis_software: OpenMSI spot set analysis tools (Rubel et al., Anal. Chem. 2013)

steps.name: Device surface preparation and oil phase loading
steps.notes: 100 uL Picoglide pumped through PDMS channel for 30 min. Novec HFE-7500 oil phase primes channel, stabilises droplets at t-junction, and enables EWOD actuation. Reversible PDMS seal assembled between DMF chip and NIMS array.

steps.name: Dextromethorphan standard preparation
steps.notes: DXM used for rudimentary validation of microfluidic droplet actuation and NIMS pad sorption. Detected at m/z 272 (H+); matrix-free ionisation; no signal on surrounding non-NIMS structures.

steps.name: DXM droplet generation at T-junction
steps.notes: Aqueous DXM plug broken into ~150 nL droplets at t-junction by immiscible HFE-7500 oil phase. Droplet synchronisation matches formation with electrode actuation for uniform spacing along central fluidics chamber.

steps.name: DXM droplet loading and incubation on NIMS pads
steps.notes: Flow stopped; 20 V hold on electrodes. 31 arrayer electrodes actuate droplets (90 V, 10 kHz, 250 ms bursts) into NIMS pad pockets for incubation. DXM sorbs onto NIMS surface. Droplets ejected after incubation. Fluorous-tagged analytes confirmed to remain adsorbed on NIMS pads in microfluidic environment.

steps.name: MALDI matrix coating
steps.notes: NIMS array removed from uNIMS system after droplet ejection. Universal MALDI matrix (20 mg/mL MeOH) applied to array surface. Array mounted in ABSciex 5800 MALDI-TOF for MS imaging.

steps.name: MS imaging QC -- DXM deposition detection
steps.ms_scan: 50 um laser step; m/z 272 ion map; OpenMSI spot set analysis

pass.meaning: DXM confirmed on NIMS pads; proceed to pH 6 kinetics

fail.meaning: No sorption detected; surfactant suppression or actuation failure

steps.notes: OpenMSI confirms DXM deposition pattern restricted to NIMS pads, not surrounding structures. Matrix-free ionisation sufficient using only NIMS surface.

steps.name: Reaction cocktail preparation (pH 6)
steps.notes: Premixed off-chip in 0.5 mL eppendorf. 4 buffer units chained via sequential mix in BioScript (compiler requires explicit merging; no multi-unit dispense). 5 uL plug drawn into syringe tubing and injected onto uNIMS.

steps.name: Reaction droplet generation at T-junction (pH 6)
steps.loading_mode: Parallel (all 31 arrayer electrodes actuated simultaneously; Fig. 4A)
steps.notes: Plug broken into ~150 nL droplets at t-junction. Central fluidics chamber filled with droplet train. Flow stopped; 20 V electrode hold. Parallel loading actuates all droplets simultaneously onto corresponding NIMS pads.

steps.name: Sequential incubation on NIMS pads (pH 6) -- 5 time points
steps.ejection: At each 10 min interval, 6 droplets synchronously ejected from pocket into central chamber and evacuated
steps.notes: G4 substrate rapidly degraded into G3, G2, G1 over 50 min. EWOD actuation (90 V, 10 kHz, 250 ms bursts) moves droplets in/out of NIMS pad pockets. Probe and products sorb to NIMS surface during incubation.

steps.name: MALDI matrix coating and MS imaging (pH 6)
steps.ms_scan: ABSciex 5800 MALDI-TOF; positive mode; 50 um laser step; focus m/z 1200; laser intensity 4150; OpenMSI spot set analysis

pass.meaning: G3/G2/G1 hydrolysis products detected; proceed to pH 5 kinetics

fail.meaning: No product signal; surfactant suppression or enzyme inactivity

steps.notes: MS imaging required (not spot analysis) due to ion suppression from HFE-7500 surfactant. Surfactant adheres to NIMS surface and reduces sensitivity; MS imaging detects all degradation products despite suppression. Fractional conversion: [G1]/([G4]+[G3]+[G2]+[G1]).

steps.name: Reaction cocktail preparation (pH 5)
steps.notes: Identical composition to pH 6 run with acetate buffer replacing phosphate buffer. Same off-chip premix procedure. Loaded continuously in series onto uNIMS (Fig. 4B).

steps.name: Reaction droplet generation at T-junction (pH 5)
steps.loading_mode: Continuous series (droplets removed from pad directly from flow; Supplementary Video)
steps.notes: Series loading used for pH 5 run. Droplets can also be removed directly from flow without pausing (vs parallel loading which requires flow halt for pH 6 run).

steps.name: Sequential incubation on NIMS pads (pH 5) -- 3 time points
steps.notes: Three time points vs five for pH 6. Final heat block is 20 m (600s gap from 20 to 40 min). CelE produces similar product distributions at pH 5 and pH 6, demonstrating enzyme robustness to process conditions (reaction profile consistent with Deng, 2015).

steps.name: MALDI matrix coating and MS imaging (pH 5)

pass.meaning: G3/G2/G1 hydrolysis products detected; experiment complete

fail.meaning: No product signal; surfactant suppression or enzyme inactivity

terminal.notes: NIMS array removed for final MS imaging. Terminal node; NOP in IR.

dxm_validation.outcome: DXM (m/z 272) detected exclusively on NIMS pads, not surrounding structures
dxm_validation.ionisation: Matrix-free; NIMS surface sufficient for ionisation
dxm_validation.ms_imaging: OpenMSI confirmed successful analyte deposition pattern

pH6_kinetics.observation: G4 rapidly degraded to G3, G2, G1 over 50 min
pH6_kinetics.note: Ion intensities low vs DXM; MS imaging required to detect all degradation products due to surfactant suppression

pH5_kinetics.observation: Similar product distributions to pH 6; CelE robust across both pH conditions

device_capacity.reagent_reduction: 150 nL droplets vs 20 uL dead volume in acoustic printing from 384-well plates
device_capacity.scalability_note: Grid of 50 um resolution gives >100,000 pads per 5 cm2 NIMS array when scaled to lower bounds of digital microfluidics; compatible with ABSciex MALDI-TOF highest scan resolution

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: PART 1 DXM validation + PART 2A pH6 cocktail + PART 2B pH5 cocktail (all dispense/mix/heat ops)
